seatConstraint.currentBad156: Butt/hip remains ahead of seat; do not assign seat weight to current B.
seatConstraint.weightTransfer: Near sole supports first; back foot must visibly land and take weight before the near foot lifts. No both-foot slide.
seatConstraint.chairHighEnoughToRequireSupport: Do not keep a distant planted foot and stretch the leg to reach these hip coordinates. After backstep, both palms brace the locked seat and support a small hip lift; feet may unweight naturally. Hips/butt must be above the seat before lowering.
seatConstraint.finalFeet: C natural hanging feet may remain only after seat bears weight. No shoe-floor contact shadow is added to hanging feet.
seatConstraint.pathRule: These are contact zones for artist alignment, not a command to slide an existing complete body across the floor.
